---
title: "County permit office experiences"
category: "General"
---

Different counties run their OSSF permitting differently. This is a thread for sharing what each office is actually like. Lead times, DR responsiveness, common rejection reasons, hours, fees.

**Coverage**

I'll start with what I know about the seven priority counties:

- **Palo Pinto County.** Public Works Department. Generally responsive. 1-3 week DR review.
- **Hood County.** Environmental Health Department. Reasonable.
- **Erath County.** Environmental Health. Steady.
- **Stephens County.** Routes via TCEQ authority finder. No verified standalone OSSF hub at build time.
- **Young County.** 911 Addressing and Permitting Office.
- **Jack County.** Public Works.
- **Eastland County.** Routes via TCEQ authority finder.

If you've filed in any of these counties recently, post what you saw. Lead time, fees, anything weird, anything good. I'll fold the useful stuff into the wiki pages.

If you want to add a county that's not on the list, also welcome.

**Format suggestion**

```
County: Palo Pinto County TX
Submitted: 2026-09-XX
DR name: (don't name publicly unless they're OK with it)
Lead time: 1-3 weeks
Fee: $250-400
What surprised me: ...
What I learned: ...
```
